statement: Verifying a merge, a reviewer put the 15 test files that import v27-no-rise in a zsh variable and passed it unquoted to vitest beside 9 named files; zsh does not word-split, so the list arrived as one filter that matched nothing, and vitest reported 9 files passed with no warning. A test runner given a filter that matches nothing runs what remains and reports green. Rules: state the expected file count before a selective run and compare it; in zsh, expand a word list with ${=var} or an array.
